topics.name: Order Delivery Management
topics.definition: Requests to change, track, or schedule delivery of an order.

topics.name: Product Returns and Refunds
topics.definition: Requests to initiate returns, check refund status, or ask about return policies.

topics.name: Order Status and Tracking
topics.definition: Requests to check where an order is, its current status, or delays.

topics.name: Payment and Billing Issues
topics.definition: Requests about payment methods, declined cards, charges, or splitting payments.

topics.name: Account and Profile Management
topics.definition: Requests to change account details, log in, log out, or manage account security.

topics.name: Product Information and Specifications
topics.definition: Requests asking for product details, dimensions, materials, or suitability.

topics.name: Product Assembly and Care
topics.definition: Requests for instructions on how to assemble, clean, or maintain a product.

topics.name: Discounts and Promotions
topics.definition: Requests about discount codes, sales, or applying promo codes to an order.

topics.name: Order Customization
topics.definition: Requests to add messages, change sizes, or modify order contents before shipping.

topics.name: Customer Support Escalation
topics.definition: Requests to speak to a human agent or get help from a live person.
